nodes.label: GoHappy Club
nodes.brief: Full Stack Developer — wellness & community platform for seniors, 17,000+ MAU.

drawerDetails.description: Built and scaled a senior-citizen wellness and community platform end-to-end as the sole engineer across mobile, backend, admin, and web.

workstreams.title: Mobile Client (React Native)
workstreams.description: Architected the application from scratch to successfully serve and support over 30,000 active senior citizen users. Standardized localization bundles supporting five Indian languages and developed remote checkout URLs to facilitate cross-generational payments.

workstreams.title: Backend (Spring Boot)
workstreams.description: Contributed approximately 697 commits across 22 months as the sole backend developer. Migrated all background cron jobs from Spring @Scheduled annotations to HTTP endpoints triggered by Google Cloud Scheduler. Engineered a budget-constrained weighted probability algorithm for gamification rewards.

workstreams.title: Admin & Web Portals (React)
workstreams.description: Developed a decoupled routing architecture with 14 main routes utilizing the React Context API. Engineered an interactive Tambola live game board featuring a 90-number visual grid and a traditional rhymes database.

nodes.label: Dr. UPSC
nodes.brief: Frontend Developer — EdTech platform for UPSC aspirants, 15,000+ MAU.

drawerDetails.description: Designed and built a full-featured UPSC EdTech web platform from scratch as the sole frontend engineer. Successfully scaled the application to serve over 15,000 active users. Implemented question prefetching to preload upcoming questions, achieving zero-latency navigation in test screens. Facilitated interactive student-mentor communication by integrating Agora video conferencing and Teachmint classrooms.

nodes.label: MayaX
nodes.brief: AI-driven interior design platform — upload a room photo, get a styled transformation.

drawerDetails.description: A React Native application providing AI-generated interior design transformations. Integrated react-native-executorch with Expo Resource Fetcher to run Llama 3.2 1B entirely on-device for prompt refinement. Architected a full data pipeline utilizing Pexels and Unsplash API scrapers, LLaVA auto-captioning, and LoRA fine-tuning. Engineered a custom loading overlay with animated skeleton cards to manage UX during complex async inference state orchestrations.

nodes.label: Blockex
nodes.brief: Native Safari extension (macOS + iOS) that blocks websites and hides YouTube Shorts.

drawerDetails.description: A cross-platform Safari extension built by integrating a Swift container app with a Manifest V3 JavaScript extension. Implements SPA navigation detection via a MutationObserver on the document subtree to intercept dynamic route transitions. Designed a total-rule-rebuild strategy for the declarativeNetRequest API to ensure consistent domain blocking. Engineered completely from scratch with zero external dependencies.

nodes.label: C_Helper
nodes.brief: Local crypto signal intelligence platform — LLM-confirmed trade setups via technical analysis.

drawerDetails.description: A local crypto signal intelligence tool watching BTC, ETH, SOL, and XRP across multiple timeframes. Designed an abstract base strategy class with a gated confidence system. Built a 6-dimension structured context builder feeding an OpenAI-compatible LLM client for signal confirmation. Developed a full backtesting engine simulating trades with realistic next-bar-open entries and implemented an asynchronous notification system via SSE pub/sub and a Telegram queue.

nodes.label: Peer Focus
nodes.brief: Real-time collaborative focus rooms with synchronized Pomodoro timers and peer accountability.

drawerDetails.description: A real-time collaborative focus application utilizing Supabase Realtime subscriptions and Firestore listeners. Developed a dual-backend abstraction layer natively switching between Supabase and Firebase via a single environment variable. Engineered a client-side timer tick engine that synchronizes to the database via debounced PATCH calls. Built a HiDPI-aware circular timer utilizing the raw Canvas 2D API for zero DOM overhead.

nodes.label: Wallulu
nodes.brief: Wallpaper discovery app — browse, filter, and download high-quality wallpapers.

drawerDetails.description: A React Native application parsing the Pixabay API for high-quality imagery. Built a responsive masonry layout using @shopify/flash-list with dynamic column counts based on device width. Engineered a custom bottom sheet modal for advanced filtering and managed complex state interactions across search queries, active categories, and pagination limits.

nodes.label: SKIT Jaipur
nodes.brief: B.Tech in Computer Science — CGPA 8.48, graduating May 2026.

drawerDetails.description: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering from Swami Keshvanand Institute of Technology, Management & Gramothan, Jaipur. CGPA: 8.48. Core coursework in Data Structures & Algorithms, System Design, DBMS, Operating Systems, and OOP.
